name: REA-L-CH1 to HICAR 200 m long-duration scientific qualification
purpose: Decide whether a seasonal or 20-year 200 m campaign is scientifically defensible, and whether a 100 m capacity qualification should proceed.

configuration.initialization: REA-L-derived skin, four-layer soil temperature and volumetric soil water, SWE, and snow height

stages.deliverable: Verified FDB GRIB layer geometry and units for SKT, T_SO, W_SO, W_SNOW, and RHO_SNOW
Conservative, tested REA-L-to-HICAR land-state conversion and publication manifest
Restart-capable summer and winter 72-hour runs with exact 24-hour checkpoints plus terrain-class, water, energy, and source-reference diagnostics
Five-segment 31-day run plus an uninterrupted overlap proving restart-trajectory equivalence, with characterized spin-up, drift, throughput, compression, and diagnostic cost
One annual-cycle qualification against REA-L and independent station/gridded observations

engineering: All wind solves meet the qualified relative-residual and mass-constraint limits
No non-finite required output or restart state
Segmented and uninterrupted overlap trajectories are equivalent
Forcing production, model execution, validation, and compression sustain the planned concurrency
initialization: No missing initialized land state over valid land cells
Soil water remapping conserves source-layer water over the represented 0-1.5 m HICAR column
Soil temperature interpolation and snow derivation pass physical-range and internal-consistency checks
Every initialization product records FDB request, source timestamp, transformations, ranges, and hashes
scientific: Spin-up transients are quantified separately from retained statistics
Water and surface-energy residuals are reported rather than hidden by incomplete output
Bias, RMSE, distribution, and trend diagnostics are stratified by elevation, terrain exposure, season, and boundary distance
No unexplained monotonic drift remains after the characterized spin-up period
Application-specific acceptance thresholds are frozen before the seasonal-cycle stage

decision_rules.launch_200m_production: Only after all stages through seasonal-cycle pass and the production output/archive contract is frozen.
decision_rules.qualify_100m: Only after the 200 m event pilots pass; then require a real 100 m geometry, GPU-memory, restart, and throughput benchmark.
decision_rules.stop_or_redesign: Stop escalation when a failure is systematic across both event pilots or cannot be attributed to initialization, output definition, boundary relaxation, or a documented HICAR limitation.

event_to_month.interpretation: These are predeclared catastrophic-degradation and pipeline-completeness screens, not application-quality or added-value thresholds.

restart_trajectory_gate.interpretation: A restarted 48-72 h summer continuation must match the uninterrupted event for every qualification field. This is an early event-scale gate and does not replace the month-scale multi-day overlap.

maximum_hicar_rmse_deterioration_relativ.precipitation_interval_kg_m2_rule: HICAR RMSE <= max(2 * REA-L RMSE, REA-L RMSE + 2 kg m-2)
maximum_hicar_rmse_deterioration_relativ.rhiresd_precipitation_rule: HICAR RMSE <= max(2 * REA-L RMSE, REA-L RMSE + 2 kg m-2)

event_to_month.decision: GO_MONTH only when both seasonal events pass every required report and catastrophic-degradation screen. A failure in one event is HOLD_AND_DIAGNOSE; the same unexplained failure in both is STOP_AND_REDESIGN.

maximum_hicar_rmse_deterioration_relativ.precipitation_interval_kg_m2_rule: HICAR RMSE <= max(1.5 * REA-L RMSE, REA-L RMSE + 1 kg m-2)
maximum_hicar_rmse_deterioration_relativ.rhiresd_precipitation_rule: HICAR RMSE <= max(1.5 * REA-L RMSE, REA-L RMSE + 1 kg m-2)

postspinup_drift_review.interpretation: A flag is not automatically numerical drift: July drying, snowmelt, and synoptic temperature evolution may be physical. Every flag requires a signed attribution as forcing-consistent, physically explained HICAR bias, or unexplained. Any unexplained flag blocks annual execution.

requirements: Seven-day restart segmentation matches an uninterrupted overlap reference within predeclared state and diagnostic tolerances.
No unexplained post-spinup monotonic drift in soil water, snow, canopy water, surface-energy closure, or near-surface climate.
HICAR and REA-L are evaluated against identical station samples plus an operational gridded precipitation and radiation reference.
Throughput, forcing overlap, compression, restart writing, validation, and archive transfer sustain the planned concurrency.
The production diagnostic profile and rolling-retention policy are frozen before annual execution.
Application-specific absolute quality limits and metric weights are approved and frozen before annual execution.
month_to_annual_cycle.decision: GO_ANNUAL_CYCLE only when every segment, solver, compression, trajectory, physical-budget, REA-L, SwissMetNet, and OGD report passes; all drift flags are explicitly attributed; no flag is unexplained; the archive contract is approved; and application-specific absolute quality limits and weights are approved and frozen. Otherwise publish a specific contract hold, HOLD_AND_DIAGNOSE, or STOP_AND_REDESIGN.

maximum_hicar_rmse_deterioration_relativ.precipitation_interval_kg_m2_rule: HICAR RMSE <= max(1.25 * REA-L RMSE, REA-L RMSE + 0.5 kg m-2)
maximum_hicar_rmse_deterioration_relativ.rhiresd_precipitation_rule: HICAR RMSE <= max(1.25 * REA-L RMSE, REA-L RMSE + 0.5 kg m-2)

requirements: All seasons and declared elevation, boundary, land, valley, neutral, and ridge subsets pass frozen absolute-quality thresholds.

HICAR does not systematically degrade REA-L across the primary temperature, precipitation, wind, radiation, and snow metrics; any claimed added value has confidence intervals and survives independent subsets.
Seasonal soil, snow, canopy, energy, and water tendencies are physically explained and do not compound across restart boundaries.
Independent-year initialization and chained-year execution have a characterized spinup-equivalence policy.
Compute allocation, failure recovery, provenance, immutable archive destination, and raw-data retirement are approved for the full campaign.
annual_cycle_to_20_year_campaign.decision: Only a passing annual cycle authorizes 20-year 200 m production.

requirements: Both 200 m event pilots pass event_to_month.
The actual national 100 m DEM and 80-level SLEVE grid satisfy minimum_mass_jacobian >= 0.1 and minimum_interface_thickness >= 5 m.
Initial and follow-up physical wind solves meet their independent true-residual targets and adjoint conservation <= 2e-5.
Measured peak memory leaves at least 15 percent headroom on every GPU and node.
A full exact-end restart is written, validated, reread, and continued without duplicate or missing output times.
Measured solver, restart, forcing, validation, and output costs replace capacity-scaled estimates and fit the available allocation and archive envelope.
event_to_100m_capacity_gate.decision: Passing this gate qualifies only 100 m engineering capacity; it does not establish 100 m scientific added value or authorize production.
